title: A desk reviewer's file (episode confidence run, design/playtest-process.md section 13)
description: What one reviewer agent writes to <run dir>/desk/<reviewer>.json. collect.mjs normalises it (core/findings.mjs#normalizeFinding) and drops any finding whose quote is not found verbatim in its cited file.

model.description: the model the agent ran on: opus or sonnet

scenes.description: the brief ids this reviewer read

verdicts.description: per brief id: would you run this scene tonight?

scene.description: brief id, or null for the whole episode

severity.description: S0 stops the session; S1 a GM would stall or a player would be lost; S2 noticeably weaker; S3 polish

quote.description: the exact words you mean, copied from the file (not paraphrased)

file.description: repo-relative path the quote is copied from

type.description: fix: a concrete change anyone could make; question: it touches meaning, reveal timing or character, so it is Ingram's call
